programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: Chef Chen Zong-sheng demonstrates his delightfully deceptive dish: Carp-Shaped Giant Fried Prawns. As carp signifies fortune and prosperity, this dish is often served at weddings and celebrations.

programs.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
programs.desc: Daren and Naana are searching for a turn-key home with a stunning ocean view. In addition, they need a location to open their dream roadside ice cream shop.

programs.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programs.desc: Rachael prepares a hearty and healthy meal for her Italian friends, combining store-bought and homemade ingredients to make flavourful, protein-rich ramen bowls.

programs.title: The Mother Flip S1E6 -A Diff-Occult Deal
programs.desc: After backing out of a deal that was too good to be true, Rebecca, Kristy and Roy are $10,000 down and desperate for a win to keep their crews working. They decide to roll the dice on a townhouse.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.desc: Rachael prepares a delicious Puerto Rican-style cold shrimp salad, also known as ensalada de Camarones, with avocado, corn and rice, that's perfect for serving as the weather turns warm.

programs.title: Theresa Caputo: Raising Spirits
programs.desc: While she is channelling, Theresa is also challenging herself by facing her fear of heights and encouraging her daughter to move into her brand new house.
